title: Craftable Treasure Enchantment Books
description: Adds recipe for Wind Burst, Soul Speed and Swift Sneak.
body:
This datapack adds a recipe to craft the following enchantments: Swift Sneek, Soul Speed, Wind Burst.

This aims to allow more players on multiplayer servers to have access to these enchantments rather than be left out due to the limited supply. The recipes use materials from the corresponding biome/location to maintain proper game progression.
